name: Colleton County, SC
findings: Colleton County has 100 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Colleton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Colleton County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
